address: 10 Argyle Street, King’s Cross, London, WC1H 8EG, United Kingdom
bio: Cacti and succulents fill the room and a DJ adds to the buzz at this deliciously different 10th floor restaurant with commanding city views. Peter Sanchez-Iglesias blends the flavours of Spain and Mexico in appealing small plates, by drawing from his father’s Spanish heritage as well as time spent in Mexico....
